Application Data.NAME: Smith Financial Advisors
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Financial Advisors provides comprehensive financial planning and investment management services to individuals and businesses. Our team of certified financial planners focuses on tailored investment strategies, retirement planning, tax optimization, and wealth management. We prioritize building long-term relationships with our clients, ensuring we understand their unique financial goals and risk tolerance. Our office is equipped with advanced technology to facilitate financial analysis and client consultations, allowing us to deliver exceptional service in a professional environment.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, our office experienced a minor water leak due to a plumbing issue, resulting in damage to carpeting and office furniture. The total cost for repairs and replacements amounted to $5,000. The claim has been filed and is currently in the status of "Pending Review." Additionally, on 07/22/2022, we faced a cybersecurity incident where a phishing attack compromised client data. We incurred $10,000 in costs related to IT security enhancements and monitoring services. This incident has been resolved, and no client financial data was lost or misused.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and regular patrols during business hours.
